stops.note: to bind, combined with re- (back, again)
to bind back, to fasten firmly, from re- and ligare
stops.meaning: to bind back, to fasten firmly

stops.note: carried into French for tying something back together, or gathering forces
stops.meaning: to tie back together, to gather forces

stops.note: settled as the English word for depending on someone or something with trust
stops.meaning: to depend on someone or something with trust

current_meaning: to depend on someone or something with confidence or trust
